age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from Solana

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

peg.description: Currency the stablecoin is pegged to

source_url.description: The issuer's own documentation for this stablecoin

canonical.description: True when the asset is in the closed registry of canonical stablecoins

extensions.description: Token-2022 extension names, in the account's order

freeze_authority_set.description: The mint can still freeze token accounts

mint_authority_set.description: The mint can still mint more of the token

token_program.description: The SPL Token or Token-2022 program that owns the mint

posture.description: The live issuer or mint facts, read now; null when the asset is not canonical or its account is missing

posture_differences.description: Every fact that changed since the snapshot, as `<field>_changed`, or `issuer_not_found` or `mint_not_found` when the canonical account is missing; empty when they match and when the asset is not canonical

posture_matches_registry.description: True when every live fact equals the recorded snapshot; null when the asset is not canonical

registry_entry.description: The registry entry: symbol, peg, issuer name and the issuer's documentation URL; null when the asset is not canonical

snapshot_date.description: The date the recorded snapshot was read; null when the asset is not canonical

description: Is this Solana mint the canonical stablecoin it claims to be? When to use: Before accepting or quoting a stablecoin: to check the mint is the canonical one and that its mint facts have not changed since the snapshot. Prefer another tool: To read supply or balances (use `/v1/solana/token/{mint}`), or as a regulatory or licensing check: none is served. Example: solana_stablecoin {"mint":"2b1kV6DkPAnxd5ixfnxCpjxmKwqjjaYmCZfHsFu24GXo"} Credits only: paid by prepaid credit, 0.0005 EUR or 0.0006 USD units per call; buy a bundle first at https://api.criptonlabs.com/v1/pro/credits/{bundle} or with `credits_topup`, then call with the `clc_` token or Sign-In-With-X.

mint.description: Mint address of an SPL Token or Token-2022 token (base58, 32 bytes)
